items.title: Samsung/Google Android XR glasses preorders open
items.notes: Preorders for the Samsung and Google Android XR 'Intelligent Eyewear' (designs with Gentle Monster and Warby Parker) reportedly open 12 Nov, with first deliveries in mid-December. The date comes from Warby Parker's co-CEO on its Q3 earnings call and from Gentle Monster's website; Samsung and Google have not confirmed it. Korean press reports preorders in Korea, the US and other major markets. No price announced yet.
